This stem is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in heaths, scrublands, and moors, and is best known in southern Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

Sap drawn from the Melem Loza vine is applied to first- or second-degree burns. It halves their effects, but deteriorates rapidly after harvesting. After two days it is no longer considered effective, so any prepared remedy should be used promptly.
